authority: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Government of India
eligibility: Private limited company, LLP, or registered partnership; entity age up to 10 years; turnover up to Rs 100 crore; working towards innovation, development or improvement of products/processes/services; scalable business model with high employment generation or wealth creation potential
benefit: Self-certification for 6 labour and 3 environmental laws; tax exemption under Section 80-IAC for 3 consecutive years; fast-track patent application with 80% rebate; access to Fund of Funds; credit guarantee scheme; exemption from prior experience/turnover in government tenders

eligibility: DPIIT-recognized startup; up to 2 years old at time of application; have a viable business idea with market fit, scalability, and technology use; not received more than Rs 10 lakh monetary support from other central/state govt schemes; Indian promoters holding at least 51% shareholding
benefit: Up to Rs 20 lakh as grant for proof of concept, prototype development, or product trials; up to Rs 50 lakh as debt/convertible debentures for market entry, commercialization, or scaling; disbursed through approved incubators
max_amount: Rs 50 lakh (Rs 20 lakh grant + Rs 30 lakh debt/convertible)

authority: Income Tax Department, Government of India
eligibility: DPIIT-recognized startup; incorporated as private limited company or LLP after 1 April 2016; turnover not exceeding Rs 100 crore in any previous year; working towards innovation, development, or improvement of products/processes/services or a scalable business model
benefit: 100% deduction of profits and gains for 3 consecutive assessment years out of 10 years from incorporation; effectively zero tax on profits for 3 years
max_amount: No upper limit (100% of profits for 3 years)
entity_age_limit: Must claim within 10 years of incorporation; 3 consecutive years benefit
deadline: Must be incorporated after 1 April 2016; claim within 10 years

authority: DPIIT, Government of India (managed by SIDBI)
eligibility: DPIIT-recognized startup; SEBI-registered Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) apply to SIDBI; startup must be invested in by approved AIFs
benefit: Government contributes up to Rs 10,000 crore to SEBI-registered AIFs; AIFs invest 2x in startups; provides equity/quasi-equity funding at various stages
max_amount: Depends on AIF investment (typically Rs 50 lakh to several crores)
entity_age_limit: No specific limit (depends on AIF criteria)

authority: DPIIT, Government of India (operated by NCGTC)
eligibility: DPIIT-recognized startup; borrowing from scheduled commercial banks, RRBs, or SIDBI; loan for business purposes; not in default with any lender
benefit: Credit guarantee up to 80% of loan amount (max Rs 10 crore); enables collateral-free loans up to Rs 10 crore; guarantee fee 0.5% per annum

scheme: Startup India Patent Fee Rebate (80% Rebate)
eligibility: DPIIT-recognized startup; patent application filed by startup
benefit: 80% rebate on patent filing fees; fast-track examination; panel of facilitators for IP applications

scheme: Income Tax Exemption under Section 56(2)(viib) - Angel Tax Exemption
authority: Income Tax Department, Government of India
eligibility: DPIIT-recognized startup; paid-up share capital and share premium not exceeding Rs 25 crore; not invested in land, building, loans, shares, jewellery, etc.
benefit: Exemption from 'angel tax' on share premium received above fair market value; no tax on investment received from eligible investors
max_amount: No upper limit (exemption on full share premium)

eligibility: DPIIT-recognized startup
benefit: Exemption from prior turnover and prior experience requirements in government tenders; can bid on GeM portal; relaxation in EMD and performance security

authority: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India
eligibility: DPIIT-recognized startup
benefit: Voluntary winding up within 90 days under Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code; simplified exit process; lower compliance burden

scheme: TANSEED - Tamil Nadu Startup Seed Fund
authority: StartupTN (Tamil Nadu Startup and Innovation Mission), Government of Tamil Nadu
eligibility: DPIIT-recognized startup; registered in Tamil Nadu; listed on StartupTN portal; early-stage startup; not formed by splitting/reconstruction of existing business; from 5th edition: 3% equity stake taken by StartupTN
benefit: Up to Rs 15 lakh for green tech, rural impact, women-led startups; up to Rs 10 lakh for other sectors; 1-year accelerator with mentorship; 25% reservation for women-led startups

eligibility: Startup founded solely by SC/ST entrepreneurs; registered in Tamil Nadu; DPIIT recognition; listed on StartupTN
benefit: Equity or debt-based investments; up to Rs 56.63 crore sanctioned across 41 startups (as of 2023-24); promotes inclusive entrepreneurship
max_amount: Varies (equity/debt investment up to Rs 50+ lakh per startup)

scheme: Tamil Nadu Emerging Sector Seed Fund
eligibility: DPIIT-recognized startup in emerging sectors (deep tech, space, AI, biotech, etc.); registered in Tamil Nadu; listed on StartupTN
benefit: Seed funding for emerging technology sectors; complements TANSEED for specialized domains

authority: StartupTN / TANSIM, Government of Tamil Nadu
eligibility: DPIIT-recognized startup in space technology; registered in Tamil Nadu; proven concept; secured third-party funding
benefit: Up to Rs 50 lakh in matching grants or equity; supports satellite systems, launch vehicles, space robotics, debris mitigation, downstream data applications

eligibility: Growth-stage startup; registered in Tamil Nadu; DPIIT recognition; private co-investment required
benefit: Government invests up to Rs 50 lakh in association with private investment agencies; 10 growth-stage startups per year

eligibility: Early-stage startup registered in Tamil Nadu; DPIIT recognition; listed on StartupTN
benefit: Vouchers for accessing incubation services, mentoring, testing facilities, and technical expertise from empanelled service providers

eligibility: Any startup registered on StartupTN portal
benefit: Connect with 257+ experienced mentors across sectors; guidance on product, strategy, fundraising, scaling; 733+ startups already connected

eligibility: Startups seeking angel investment; investors wanting to invest in TN startups
benefit: Platform connecting Tamil Nadu startups with angel investors; education for aspiring investors; enables emerging angel networks across state

eligibility: Tamil Nadu-based startups seeking funding
benefit: Platform connecting TN founders with funding agencies worldwide; access to global investors and funds

eligibility: Incubators in Tamil Nadu
benefit: Workshops, grants, and global best practices for incubators; enhances incubator sustainability and effectiveness; 124+ incubators across state

eligibility: Tamil Nadu-based startups; DPIIT recognition preferred
benefit: Television exposure on national/regional channels; awareness raising; investor visibility; prizes and recognition for winners
